title: PureHealth’s insurance vertical, Daman, receives Moody’s A1 Insurance Financial Strength Rating
excerpt: PureHealth has announced that its insurance vertical, The National Insurance Company - Daman, has been assigned an A1 Insurance Financial Strength Rating (IFSR) by Moody’s Ratings with a stable outlook. The post PureHealth’s insurance vertical, Daman, receives Moody’s A1 Insurance Financial Strength Rating appeared first on PureHealth .
